component.name: Software Updater
component.summary: Install critical, security, main and Flatpak updates

description.p: Software Updater installs critical, security and main updates for DebION GNU/Linux from the configured package sources, using PackageKit or APT, and updates Flatpak applications. Updates are grouped like in a classic software updater; each group and package can be unchecked before choosing Install Now.
Software Updater was called SDE Update before Alpha 51; the command is still sde-update.
Update model adapted from Linux Mint's Update Manager (mintupdate) by Clement Lefebvre and the Linux Mint team.
Developed by the DebION Dev-Team for the Selviana Desktop Environment.
